title: Fixed dead-code band tint bug: rowObj._band_id always undefined after remap()
body: Fixed dead-code bug in XLSX band tint: `getBandIndex(bandIds, rowObj._band_id)` at export.ts:475 always returned -1 because `remap()` strips `_band_id` from cleanRows (it's in XLSX_INTERNAL_COLS). Replaced with index-based lookup: `bandIds[r - 1]` to read from the parallel array directly. Removed the now-unused `getBandIndex` helper. Updated test fixtures to remove `_band_id` from cleanRows, matching production flow where band info comes exclusively from the `bandIds` parallel array. Key insight: tests passed before because fixtures manually included `_band_id` in cleanRows — a fixture/production mismatch that masked the bug.

title: Fixed 4 MINOR QA issues for Plan A ingestion
body:
Fixed 4 MINOR QA issues for TASK-column-type-aware-where-A-ingestion:

1. CONTRACTS.md line 73 — corrected inaccurate claim that CSV imports store no colTypes. scanCellTypes returns all-string records for CSV files, so the conditional spread DOES include them (redundant but harmless). Updated text to match actual behavior.

2. Added test: null header cell — verifies columns with v:null in header row are silently dropped from result.

3. Added test: sparse dense array — verifies null rows between data rows in dense arrays are skipped (exercises if (!row) continue at loader.ts:127).

4. Added test: all-skipped column — verifies columns with valid headers but all error/stub/null data cells are absent from result.

All verification passed: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0 warnings, 923/923 tests pass (52 files).
